snippet.title: Sealbreakers - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Sealbreakers, a top-down 3D roguelite action brawler developed by Fire Sparrow Studio. Players will embody a disgraced warrior who fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists. Sealbreakers is coming soon to PC (Steam).
